name: @orbb/notifications
description: Deterministic notification/reminder engine for ORBB (M6-B Lane A, B8): pure schedule computation over @orbb/measurement task snapshots — upcoming-due REMIND rung, missed-window detection escalating to REMIND_WITH_FALLBACK_OFFER (journey #7: the fallback-provider offer is DATA, never a decision — the engine offers the task's recorded fallback vocabulary and never orders a provider), preference-gated quiet hours 22:00-07:00 local-of-record with defer-to-edge (never drop), and idempotent dispatch through a fail-closed NotificationChannel abstraction with a send-attempt ledger and TASK_DUE event emission through the contracts envelope. Interface-driven: injected clock/id-factory/ledger/event-sink/channel registry; zero external runtime dependencies; no provider SDKs (WebPush/Email arrive as seam-only SYNTH doubles).
